# CodeEdit completion UI adaptation

- Upstream: https://github.com/CodeEditApp/CodeEditSourceEditor
- Revision: `1fa4d3c3ffba007482111466cb9721416f97ae00`
- License: MIT, retained verbatim in `LICENSE.md`.
- Source: `Sources/CodeEditSourceEditor/CodeSuggestion/`.

`CodeSuggestionRowView` retains the upstream inset-selection drawing and its
full-row repaint workaround. `CodeSuggestionLabelView`, `CodeSuggestionItem`, and
`SuggestionController` adapt the upstream label/detail/icon model, child-window
placement, focus-loss teardown, keyboard handling, list sizing, and preview area.
The upstream TextViewController, SwiftUI theme, and Tree-sitter dependencies are
replaced with a narrow AppKit interface driven by Duckpad's Scintilla adapter.
Matching and insertion remain outside the UI module. No CodeEdit editor engine
or STTextView implementation is included. Files are maintained in-tree and are
not generated by a vendoring script.

The documentation preview uses a selectable, wrapping NSTextView in its own
scroll view instead of a five-line label. Its measured height is capped at 160 pt;
the complete bounded text remains scrollable. Layout keeps whole candidate rows,
separates documentation from candidates, clamps the panel to its parent and screen,
and resets documentation scroll position on selection changes. Asynchronous
resolution uses the same layout path as initial presentation.
The documentation viewport is sized before its text document, with an explicit
wrapping width. This avoids combining clip-view autoresizing with a second text
width adjustment when lazy resolution expands a previously empty preview.

Duckpad's local theme integration supplies the shared editor panel, border,
foreground, muted and selection colors via `CodeSuggestionTheme`. Rows use
compact code typography and small monochrome symbols. Source labels and the
visible keyboard-help footer are omitted; keyboard help remains accessible.
Panel layout is bounded by the parent content frame as well as the screen,
chooses space above/below the caret, and keeps documentation in a separate
scrolling viewport. These files remain locally maintained, not generated.
